description: Reviewed named sites whose project-title phrases identify a PSGC barangay inside a multi-district city. Every phrase in match_all must occur after punctuation-insensitive folding.

sites.name: Barangay 628
sites.evidence_note: PUP identifies its College of Engineering at the NDC Compound in Sta. Mesa; the retained campus point falls in Barangay 628 and Manila 6th in the NCR barangay geometry.

sites.name: Barangay 410
sites.evidence_note: PUP places Rizal Campus on S.H. Loyola (formerly Lepanto) in Sampaloc; its P. Campa/S.H. Loyola site falls in Barangay 410 and Manila 4th.

sites.name: U.P. Campus
sites.evidence_note: The official UP Resilience Institute record places the institute at Quezon Hall, UP Diliman; U.P. Campus barangay maps to Quezon City 4th.
